r: You’ll set the direction for KSA operations across Trading (Brokerage and Custody) Ops, Financial Ops and Account Opening. You’ll design the operating model, the control framework and the team, and you’ll be accountable to leadership and the CMA for how the function performs. Specifically:
End-to-end ownership of settlement, end-of-day and reconciliation cycles across Tadawul, Muqassa and Edaa, with controls that scale as volumes grow
The full corporate actions lifecycle, including dividends, bonus shares, rights issues, IPOs and tender offers, with accuracy and timeliness standards set by you
Funding operations across Saudi banking channels
Incident management as a core operational discipline, from response playbooks through root-cause reviews and prevention

Building, leading and developing the KSA operations team across trading, money movement and account opening

x: At Thndr, we believe that investing is a right. That anyone with a smartphone deserves to invest, regardless how much money they make.
For lifestyle investors, we offer easy access to local and US stocks, funds managed by professionals, and an AI-enabled experience to build and manage a personalized portfolio.
We also produce relatable financial content, which we post on social media platforms consumers already love and use.

For advanced traders, we offer an institutional-grade trading platform called ThndrX. We built ThndrX specifically to meet the needs of a trader. It offers advanced charts & data, custom screeners, trade-by-trade analytics, research coverage, and more.

There is no doubt that improving trust and participation in local capital markets is crucial for Saudi’s Vision 2030, and its stated goals of economic resilience and diversification. As an investment broker, we clearly see the role we can play in driving investment into productive local companies.
We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:
21B SAR volume traded in H1 2026 (3.7x YoY growth), 14% of all volume traded on the Egyptian Stock Exchange in H1 2026
15m trades, 35% of all trades on the Egyptian Stock Exchange
#1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year
40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we also launched Rumble, a subscription-based platform for investment recommendations. Rumble gives users in-depth advice straight from its team of licensed stock analysts.
We're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.
